name: Anna Leybina
abstract_title: Modeling Serendipity: Toward Conscious Career Design in Complex Environments
abstract: In today’s rapidly changing labor markets, individuals face a fundamental challenge: how can a person consciously shape their professional future when knowledge becomes outdated faster than traditional career theories can explain? History is full of examples where people’s careers transformed because of skills they learned “by accident,” chance encounters, or knowledge they gained long before realizing its importance.
